payout_quote: Get $100 at H-D. Just spend $500 on your H-D Visa card in the first 90 days.
steps: Open the official Harley-Davidson Visa page (h-dvisa.com) and read the offer terms.
Apply for the H-D Visa Signature card (issued by U.S. Bank); a hard credit inquiry is part of the application.
Spend at least $500 on the card in the first 90 days — only purchases you already planned.
Pay the balance in full each month.
Receive $100 in H-D value (points redeemable at Harley-Davidson: 2,500 points = $25 at H-D).
catches: Never spend extra solely to earn the bonus — only count the $500 of purchases you were already going to make.
No annual fee ($0), so the $100 H-D value is yours to keep net if you meet the spend.
Applying triggers a hard inquiry on your credit report, which can temporarily lower your score.
Carried-balance interest erases the bonus: after the 0% intro APR (9 billing cycles), the variable APR is 17.49%-30.49% — always pay in full.
The $100 is H-D-only value (gift cards/Chrome Cash usable at Harley-Davidson), not general cash — worth $100 only if you buy H-D gear, parts, or apparel.
biggest_catch: The bonus is $100 in Harley-Davidson-only value, not cash — only worth it if you already buy H-D merchandise; and never stretch spending to hit the $500, since the 17.49%-30.49% APR after the intro period wipes out the bonus if you carry a balance.
eligibility: New H-D Visa cardholders; $500 in purchases within the first 90 days of account opening.
timing: Bonus awarded after the $500/90-day requirement is met; exact posting timing not stated in the fetched copy.
